answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the sonnet of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The bridge is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ocean. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, capped per identity per epoch, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
